title: Clienti & fornitori
summary: Product scope for the LocalMind enterprise Customers & Suppliers extension: a unified weighted CRM/SRM knowledge graph with local GraphRAG over organizations, contracts, interactions and supply dependencies.
scope: Unified CRM/SRM weighted knowledge graph (Customer 360 / Supplier 360)

Graph node types: Organizzazione, Persona, Sede, Contratto, Opportunita, Ordine, Fattura, Interazione, Prodotto/Servizio, Componente/MateriaPrima, AreaGeografica, CategoriaSpesa, RischioConcentrazione

Graph relation/edge types: HA_RUOLO, CONTROLLA, HA_REFERENTE, PRESIDIA, RIPORTA_A, HA_CONTRATTO, HA_OPPORTUNITA, HA_ORDINE, HA_FATTURA, HA_INTERAZIONE, ACQUISTA, RICHIEDE, FORNISCE, LOCALIZZATO_IN, GARANTISCE, ALTERNATIVO_A, ESPONE_A, SIMILE_A
Edge weighting: legame cliente-azienda, criticita fornitore, forza relazione interpersonale, salute relazione, rischio concentrazione, SIMILE_A semantic
Entity resolution (chiavi forti P.IVA/VAT/DUNS, chiavi deboli, auto-merge + coda revisione umana)

MVP feature set: graph model on MySQL+Qdrant, CSV/Excel + 1 CRM connector, base entity resolution, email interaction ingestion + local sentiment, Vista 360, interactive graph exploration, base weights/indicators, GraphRAG Q&A with citations, contract-expiry alerts, IT/EN bilingualism

Evolution feature set: native ERP connectors, multi-tier dependency chain, structural risk engine (SPOF, key-person, concentration), what-if simulation, churn/deterioration prediction, advanced entity resolution, dashboards, contract multimodal extraction

Data connectors: CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Dynamics/Pipedrive REST), ERP/gestionale (SAP/Dynamics/Odoo DB+API, BOM), Email IMAP module, Calendar module, Contracts/documents (Tika+OCR), CSV/Excel importer, external enrichment (registri imprese/DUNS/geo-risk, opt-in)
Risk analysis: single point of failure, supply dependency chain, revenue/spend concentration, key-person risk, geographic exposure
Local-first privacy (Ollama default, no cloud without opt-in), GDPR, PF4J plugin/marketplace distribution
Personas: Sales manager, Account/Sales rep, Procurement, Buyer/Category manager, Risk/Compliance, CFO, Customer Success, Self-hoster/Data engineer
KPIs: graph quality, coverage, risk visibility, AI citation accuracy, on-prem flow percentage
notes: Content-only signals (no YAML frontmatter, no filename/path convention). PRD dominates: personas, detailed input requirements, goals/non-goals, MVP-vs-evolution feature set, KPIs/success metrics. Competing SPEC signals present in section 5 (graph node/relation data model + weight formulas) and section 6 (connector tables); SPEC has higher precedence but PRD strength is clearly dominant, so classified PRD with the SPEC overlap recorded here for the synthesizer.
